name: LLaDA2.2-mini

lineage.how_derived: agentic reinforcement learning with L-EBPO (Levenshtein Editing ELBO-based Block-level Policy Optimization) on top of the LLaDA2.0-mini MoE diffusion architecture, adding DELETE and INSERT control tokens

purpose: A lightweight agentic diffusion language model: long-context tool calling, multi-turn interaction and error correction through Levenshtein editing, with a small active parameter count to cut inference cost.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card tag apache-2.0; no LICENSE file in the repo (404 on raw/main/LICENSE, 2026-11-19), text not read.

architecture.kind: MoE diffusion language model (block diffusion) with Levenshtein editing
architecture.drafter: none (parallel block decoding with confidence threshold)
architecture.why_this_design: Card: 128K context with a Block Routing mechanism that restricts MoE expert activation at the diffusion-block level, enabling efficient long-context agentic tasks; DELETE and INSERT tokens let parallel decoding remove redundant content and create insertion points; agentic RL trains those edits against environment rewards.

variants.notes: sizes not recorded; also MLX 4/5/6 bit builds by one community author

pc-12gb.notes: 1.4 B active but the card documents only the Transformers sampler; a quant of the 16 B would be about 9 GB

pc-16gb.notes: BF16 32.5 GB needs RAM offload; quantization untested

pc-32gb.notes: 32.5 GB is about the whole VRAM budget (29.6 GB), some experts in RAM

mac-16-24gb.notes: BF16 does not fit; a 4-bit MLX build exists from a community author

mac-32gb.notes: MLX 6-bit would be about 12 GB (community, unverified)

engine_support.notes: Open discussion asks for vLLM or llama.cpp support; a community GGUF exists but diffusion decoding support in llama.cpp was not checked.

strengths: Large gains in function calling and long context over LLaDA2.1-mini (vendor)
weaknesses: Reasoning and knowledge scores below LLaDA2.1-mini (AIME 2026 35.1 against 40.4, GPQA 44.4 against 48.4, vendor)
Diffusion decoding is not supported by common local engines
soft.behavior: Generates blocks of 32 tokens in parallel with a confidence threshold (card example gen_length 512, block_length 32, threshold 0.5).
soft.maturity: inclusionAI (Ant Group) LLaDA line with 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2; 3.5k downloads, four discussions.

tona_fit.reason: Coding score is weak and the diffusion decoder is outside Tona's autoregressive engine; useful only as prior art for block-level expert routing in long-context decoding.

sources.note: titles read via the HF API

open_questions: Real decode speed of block diffusion on consumer GPUs
Quantization and GGUF quality (community repo only)
